items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: I think his name is John.

ctx.x: Well, and he has a son, he has a son here, too. He's, in some kind of, he was in business up on, on Calton Avenue right off of St. Charles. Uh, and he was on, on Canal right off of, uh, off of Camp Street there for a while. But the last time I saw he was up here on Calton Avenue. I think his name is John. What were you gonna say about Hardy?
I was wondering, you told me once, uh, when I was fishing in the hospital about him being sick so long, and you'd go by and see him all the time.
